description: The JH-15 RTO office serves the Deoghar district in Jharkhand, handling essential services such as vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection. Deoghar is a major religious destination, and this office manages transport logistics for both local residents and the significant tourist influx to the Baidyanath Temple area.
address: District Transport Office, Court Campus, Deoghar, Jharkhand
